text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 page — multiple containers restarted due to GPU OOMs during prefill on cluster-us-west-2. Signs point to long-context prefill tokens spiking. Logs attached: /logs/1829006543/prefill-oom.*
alex (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. hitting the cluster now to gather counts.
maya (sre): Seeing repeated SIGKILL on worker pods, OOM summary: ~120 restarts in the last 8m, 2 nodes flapping. OOMs correlate with requests > 30k tokens prefill.
jordan (runtime): Confirmed. Prefill code path isn't trimming long-system prompts for streaming requests; big customers send whole context for embeddings+chat. Heap/KV cache grows and triggers OOM. Stacktrace snippet: `nv::out_of_memory at cuda.cu:421`
leon (engops): Traffic breakdown: ~2.3% of total requests but ~18% of GPU memory pressure; 3 customers show repeated failures (acct ids masked). Likely customer-facing 5xxs for long-window routes.
clara (support): Notified account managers for the 3 affected customers, collecting ETA expectations. Customers seeing mid-request disconnects.
alex (oncall): First live mitigation: scale down max concurrent prefill per-pod and enable aggressive KV eviction on the 2 flapping nodes. Commands: ```kubectl patch deployment runtime-worker -n us-west-2 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"MAX_PREFILL_CONCURRENCY","value":"2"},{"name":"KV_EVICTION_TRIGGER_RATIO","value":"0.6"}]}}]}}}}'```
jordan (runtime): Pushing a tiny hotpatch to runtime to cap prefill tokens server-side (non-persistent) to avoid long tails: set MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=4096 for the affected lane. Will push with zero-downtime config rollout.
maya (sre): After concurrency cap + eviction we see reduced restart rate, node1 stabilized, node2 still has one noisy restart every ~3m. Memory graphs: https://grafana/redwood/1829006543.
leon (engops): Routing change: shifting long-window traffic to warmpool nodes with higher VRAM and disabled prefetch for a while. Implemented route rule: if prefill_tokens > 4096 -> route to warmpool or reject with 413.
alex (oncall): Customer-facing update ready: "We're mitigating an issue that caused long-context requests to cause GPU memory exhaustion leading to restarts. We've applied temporary caps and routing to reduce impact; an ops patch is in progress. We will follow up with root cause and timeline." Clara, please send.
clara (support): Sent to customers at 1829006900. Two requested immediate throttles; one asked to re-send truncated context — doing that now.
jordan (runtime): Deploy of MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=4096 completed at 1829007000 across us-west-2. Hotpatch diff: `- allow_unbounded_prefill: true
+ allow_unbounded_prefill: false
+ max_prefill_tokens: 4096`
maya (sre): Post-patch: restarts dropped from 120->9 in 20m, no further node flaps observed. Monitoring for 30m then consider closing.
alex (oncall): Handoff note for night: keep MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS at 4096 until the runtime team ships a durable guard and we roll out a graceful degradation policy for >16k windows. If restarts resume, escalate to oncall-lead.
leon (engops): Follow-up tasks assigned: runtime durable limiter (jordan), smarter routing + reject message (leon), customer postmortem + SLAs (clara).
clara (support): I'll schedule a customer post-incident call for tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to MONITORING by alex (oncall). :white_check_mark:
